item.title: Poem
item.description: Poem for today A day that allowed for roaming and circling While the prayer group took aim at a labyrinth. Thin places, they speak to me, My significant space, what previously I might have called Spirit, opens up like a lily bud turning toward its prime mover. They said of him at the time for eulogies That he had formed the habit of leaving a space, a room, a clean-up effort, or the tidying of the evening colloquy,
